title: OpenAI's Empire Building: 8,000 Employees and the Astral Acquisition
author: Howard
summary: OpenAI plans to double headcount to 8,000 by end of 2026 while acquiring Astral, makers of uv, Ruff, and ty. The company is building a desktop 'superapp' consolidating ChatGPT, Atlas, and Codex into one unified experience.
